deadline.value: PhD applications are due December 15 for fall admission.
deadline.quote: For the PhD and thesis MS program our deadline is December 15th.

gre_subject.value: GRE scores are not required for application.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores (general and subject) are not required for application to our program.

supervisor.value: A research advisor is not required, but finding one significantly raises chances of admission.
supervisor.quote: While not required, finding a research advisor who is interested in having you join their lab significantly increases your chances of admission.

funding.value: Admitted PhD students are accepted only with full funding through a teaching or research assistantship.
funding.quote: We only accept students into our PhD and thesis Master’s program with full funding via either a teaching or research assistantship.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is enough; a master's is not required to apply to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Note that a master's degree is not required for application to the Ph.D. program.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required for application.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores (general and subject) are not required for application to our program.

fee_waiver.value: There is no general waiver; applicants with financial hardship can ask the Director of Graduate Studies.
fee_waiver.quote: No, but if you have a financial hardship preventing you from paying for the application fee, please contact the Director of Graduate Studies.

notes: The FAQ still gives TOEFL 79 (old scale) for international applicants; the Graduate School's rule for exams after January 21, 2026 (4.0 new scale) is used, so no TOEFL override is set. Confirm with the department.
